description: Cancel an email that hasn't started going out: one scheduled for later, or one still waiting its turn. If the email came from a draft, you get the draft back to edit, and its revision goes up by one. An email that has started going out can't be canceled (409). If the email is already canceled, nothing changes and you get the send back as it is. Canceling needs the permission that sends that kind of email: `transactional` for a transactional email, `send` for the rest (403 without it).

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: cancel_send
title: Cancel a send
